node.label: India's neighbourhood
node.summary: India's ties with Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Maldives and other South Asian neighbours ('Neighbourhood First').

facts.text: Bhutan dedicated Chorten No. 76 of its **108 Buddhist stupas** (Jangchub Chortens), built in a nine-hour effort by 40,000+ volunteers, to PM Narendra Modi, as part of the India-backed Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC) project.

facts.text: A Bangladesh court sentenced Awami League joint general secretary **Mahbubul Alam Hanif** to death in absentia for killings during the **2024 uprising**; the UN says about **1,400** were killed in July-Aug 2024.
